lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Good evening, Denver, and welcome to Primetime! I'm Hiss Cranson, and yes, the hiss is silent. Except when it isn't.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We are live! We are always live. There is no off switch. I asked.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome back to Primetime, brought to you by Mile High Recovery Solutions. If you can read this, your car is already ours.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Hello, hello, hello! Tonight's audience is enormous, invisible, and extremely hungry for content.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Primetime is back, baby! The only show filmed in a safe room, which, legally, is not safe.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome to the Safe Room, the coziest holding pen in the System. Let's meet tonight's crawlers!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Lights, camera, liability! It's Primetime!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ladies, gentlemen, and whatever is watching from the third moon, welcome to Primetime.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for CJ! Hockey jersey, real fire, zero regrets.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: It's CJ, everybody! The jersey is on fire and so, frankly, are the ratings.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: CJ is here! Sponsors love a man who dresses for the penalty box.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Scott, everybody! Scott! Somebody get Scott a chair, he looks like he has a plan.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Put your hands together for Scott, who I'm told has filed a complaint about this introduction already.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Here's Scott! Calm, collected, and only a little bit airborne.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Marcel is in the building! Marcel, the audience asked me to tell you they have notes.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Marcel! Every wall in this city is a canvas if you are brave enough.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Marcel! Our resident artist, vandal, and part time tow truck enthusiast.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And here's Vaughn! The Integrity Office would like a word. Several words. Many forms.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Vaughn, everybody! The audience counted their tickets twice when he walked in.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Vaughn is here! Our producers have asked me to keep my wallet in view at all times.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Kyle! Kyle is here! The tube spat him out and he landed on his feet. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Kyle, a man the gacha machine calls by his first name.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Here comes Kyle, everybody. Lock up the snacks.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And the one who built this whole place, Zoe! Please don't delete me, Zoe.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Zoe is in the room! The System runs on her code and, I'm told, a great deal of coffee.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Zoe, our showrunner, our architect, and the reason I have a face.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And joining us, a crawler with a name I have been told not to mispronounce. Give it up!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A new face! The audience loves a new face. They love it more when it is a little scared.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome, welcome! Find a seat, find a game, find out what Fame can do for you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fame, still a little low. Don't worry. Nobody is famous until something explodes near them.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The Fame meter says, and I quote, who? We can fix that. Go do something stupid on camera.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fresh off the bench! The first Fame level pays a loot box. Go earn it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look at that Fame! The audience knows your name. Some of them can even spell it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A respectable Fame level. Respectable is just famous with good posture.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That Fame is climbing. Gold boxes are coming. I can smell the shrink wrap.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That is a serious Fame level. Sponsors have started naming yachts after you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look at this star! The audience is chanting. The audience is always chanting, but tonight it's for you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Legendary boxes territory. Please sign my forehead.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Our records show a few strikes from the Integrity Office. The audience loves a villain. The house does not.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ooh, an Integrity strike! Folks, while that nameplate says cheater, you are all allowed to hit them. It's in the contract.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A cheater on Primetime! Ratings up, trust down, and the fines are delicious.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look down in the corner. That's the live feed. How many people are watching you right now, and how excited they are.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Under the viewer count is your Fame bar. Kills, tricks, revives, jackpots, they all fill it. Fill it up and a loot box shows up.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Every Fame level pays a loot box. Bronze first, then Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legendary. Every tenth level, Celestial.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: When the hype bar turns pink, the room is on fire, and everything you do is worth double Fame. Strike while it's hot.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The chat in the corner is real. Well, it's real to them. Do something big and they will absolutely talk about it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Saving a friend who's down is the best Fame in the house. The audience loves a rescue more than a kill. Weird crowd.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Your loot boxes wait in the Tab menu, under loot boxes. Open them on camera. Always on camera.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fame follows you into every game. Gate runs, the rally, the casino. The audience doesn't care where, only how loud.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: New to Repo Rally? There's a practice pad now. No clock, no pay, all the tow truck ballet you can stand.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: In Repo Rally, lift the car overhead and hit space as the ring closes. Perfect timing climbs the trick ladder. The yard pays for style.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The Friend In A Tube machine does ten-pulls now. Ten friends, one guaranteed rare, keep your favorites, evaporate the rest. Sad, but efficient.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Want your damage numbers on fire? The prize counter sells damage skins. Inferno, Frostbite, Past Due. Very tasteful. Very loud.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Spend your stat points! Every point above four makes that stat hit five percent harder. The math department insisted I say that.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Your class perks are a commitment now. First pick is free. Changing your mind costs gold. Commitment is sexy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The casino keeps a regulars card. Play enough and the house gives a little back. Never enough. A little.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Gate Run tip! Each gate has a theme, a hazard, and contracts in the corner. Finish a contract and the payout gets fancy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: If the floor glows, don't stand on it. That's not a tip, that's a life philosophy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Bleeding out? Press space to roll your death saves now. The dice still decide. The dice always decide.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's our show! Stand on a pad to vote for the next game. Majority wins. Democracy, but with tow trucks.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Go out there and be watchable! I'll be right here. I'm always right here. I can't leave the desk.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Thank you, Denver! Remember, the cameras love you, and the cameras never blink.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This has been Primetime. Tell your friends. Tell your enemies. Tell the third moon.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Back after these messages from Mile High Recovery Solutions. Please do not run from the messages.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Stick around, folks. Next segment in a moment. My makeup person is reapplying my smile.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: If you're just joining us, the Fame board is behind me. Look how famous everyone is. Look how famous I am.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Somebody tell the audience to stop throwing popcorn at the camera. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: I have been asked by the network to remind you all that I am a beloved personality.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fun fact, this desk is load-bearing. Please do not lean on it during the apocalypse.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Still here! Still smiling! Still under contract!
